description: NaTi₃AlO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cm space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.82 Å. There are three inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra, corners with three TiO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.26 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlO₆ octahedra, corners with three TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.17 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with three TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-28°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-2.18 Å. Al is bonded to six O atoms to form AlO₆ octahedra that share corners with two TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₆ octahedra, and edges with five TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-22°. There are a spread of Al-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.08 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two Ti, and one Al atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ti, and one Al atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Ti and one Al atom to form distorted corner-sharing OTi₃Al trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ti and two equivalent Al atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Ti and one Al atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Ti atoms.
